comment: Pagan stitched world layout (PLAN-WORLD-EDITOR.md section 1; engine/NOTES.md 'The stitched world'). Each group's maps are placed in one world space: offset [dx, dy, dz] (world units, dz = 256 x layer) is added to every item. 'derived' says how each was found. Seams are walkable joins, links are kept as teleports. Edit freely (also in the editor); regenerate with: pagan --write-world-layout FILE (keeps areas[] and unknown fields).
